messages:
rita: quick threadnoticed noisy evictions during this morning's rollout. tenant cohorts A+B saw increased OOMs and QoR variance. we only have model_ref+tag in the rollout manifest today. need richer attribution.

omar: agreed. without variant-level details it's guessing. can we add a compact "diagnostic_vector" that is a small enum list for quick aggregation? e.g. ["high_mem_path","kv_cache_pressure","long_seq_routing"].

jay: +1 to diagnostic_vector. also propose we include `deploy_snapshot` with tiny ints: `peak_rss_mb`, `active_kv_mb`, `allocated_buffers`. keep it optional and tiny.

sylvie: prefer names: `peak_rss_mb` -> `observed_rss_mb` and `allocated_buffers` -> `scratch_mb` to be explicit. also add `kernel_hint` (string enum) so we know which optimized kernel family was chosen.

omar: we should avoid free text for `kernel_hint`. make it an enum: ["matmul_opt_v1","matmul_opt_v2","sparse_attn"].

jay: how do we keep rollout manifests small? make all these optional and require `schema_version` when present; analytics treats absent as `unknown`.

sylvie: add `pin_scope` field: ["global","tenant","route"] so we can reason about eviction blast radius. current pinning is opaque.

omar: rollback semantics: set `manual_rollback=true` and include `rollback_note` and `rollback_actor` in the manifest change event so automated reapply logic can skip it for a cooldown window.

jay: telemetry join: add a short `telemetry_anchor_id` (uuid string) that ties the rollout to a telemetry timeline. makes joins trivial.

sylvie: ops ask: can we also expose `client_seq_distribution_buckets` (very small list like "<=256","257-1024",">1024") as an optional hint when we pin variants for long-seq? this will help decide max_seq gating.

omar: implementor note: storage should stay flat (no nested objects). we can keep each optional value as top-level keys in the manifest with a `schema_version` marker.

jay: i'll draft the RFC patch with: field list, enums, sample JSON manifest snippet (small), and an analytics backfill SQL that maps old manifests -> inferred fields using deploy logs.

sylvie: please include recommended SLO tweaks for eviction-sensitive customers and a rollout playbook section: how to opt-in/out of kernel variants.
